title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Embedded dashboard filter APIs**: In embedded dashboards, you can now set and retrieve filter values through APIs. See [Control dashboard filters programmatically](/aws/en/dashboards/share/embedding/external-embed#filter-apis).
* **Ranked table calculations in `/importBI`**: Importing reports from Power BI and Tableau with the `/importBI` Genie Code command now includes ranked table calculations.
* **Color mappings**: In a dashboard's theme settings, you can assign a specific color to a value by name. Any visualization that colors by that value uses the assigned color across the dashboard, for both color by field and color by series. See [Consistent colors across widgets](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations#color-consistency).
* **Rich text for dynamic data references**: You can now apply rich text formatting to [dynamic data references](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations#reference-filter) in text widgets, widget titles, and descriptions.
* **Dashboard variable improvements**: Enhancements to dashboard variables:
  + **Multiple fields**: Viewers can now add, remove, and swap multiple fields through a dashboard variable on a visualization, instead of switching one field at a time. See [Use dashboard variables](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters/dashboard-variables).
  + **Source dataset for options**: Dashboard variable options now show their source dataset as a subtitle. See [Create a dashboard variable](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters/dashboard-variables#create-a-variable).
* **Metric view downloads respect display names**: Downloads from a metric view now use the display names defined for its fields. See [Local metric views](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/data-modeling/local-metric-views).
* **Always-visible scrollbars on faceted charts**: Scrollbars now stay visible on scrollable [faceted charts](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations#faceting).
* **Data attachments in Slack and Teams**: Dashboard subscriptions delivered to Slack and Microsoft Teams can now include data attachments in CSV, TSV, or Excel format. See [Data attachments](/aws/en/dashboards/share/schedule-subscribe#email-attachments).
* **Cross-dataset filtering through relationships (Public Preview)**: When datasets are connected by a relationship, filters, selections, and parameters applied to one dataset now automatically carry across to widgets built on the related datasets. See [Create dashboard relationships](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/data-modeling/dashboard-relationships/create-relationships).
* **Genie Code for dashboard authoring**: New authoring capabilities and fixes for Genie Code:
  + **Improved automatic widget layout**: When Genie Code adds widgets to a dashboard, it now places them in available layout space automatically.
  + **Smoother editing**: Genie Code no longer appears to stall between edits, and multi-step edits apply with less delay between steps.
